name: Projection Failure Mode Atlas Registry
purpose: Create an atlas of failure modes for projection-derived structures across all current domains.

failure_mode_classes.name: equality_overflattening
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projected equality is mistaken for full ⇔R equivalence.

failure_mode_classes.name: implication_sequentialization
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projected implication is mistaken for primitive process ordering or causation.

failure_mode_classes.name: composition_chain_reification
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projected composition is mistaken for real sequential construction of process aspects.

failure_mode_classes.name: biconditional_truth_flattening
failure_mode_classes.definition: Logical biconditional is mistaken for residue-bound recursive closure.

failure_mode_classes.name: projection_recoverability_overclaim
failure_mode_classes.definition: A projection is claimed to reconstruct its ⇔R source relation without sufficient trace metadata.

failure_mode_classes.name: multi_projection_identity_error
failure_mode_classes.definition: Agreement between projections is mistaken for source identity or proof of the whole relation.

failure_mode_classes.name: geometry_primitive_promotion
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projection-induced geometry-like structure is promoted to primitive or physical geometry.

failure_mode_classes.name: persistence_ontology_reification
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projection persistence behavior is mistaken for independent ontology.

failure_mode_classes.name: orientation_primitive_reification
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projection-induced orientation behavior is treated as independently primitive.

failure_mode_classes.name: physical_escalation_from_projection
failure_mode_classes.definition: Projection-derived structures are used to claim physical derivation, QM/GR unification, or physical law status.

mitigation_rules.rule: Any projection failure must restore source_relation traceability.
Any overflattened expression must be relabeled as projection-derived.
Any physical escalation from projection must be rejected.
Any recoverability overclaim must be downgraded to trace-recoverable or not-recoverable.
Any primitive promotion attempt requires separate governance and cannot occur inside this atlas.

forbidden_uses: Using the atlas to promote projection failures into theorem targets.
Treating failure detection as proof of source relation.
Treating projection failure as invalidation of ⇔R.
Using projection failure modes as physical evidence.
Removing source traceability from failure records.
